ncp730_ds.title: NCP730 LDO Regulator, 150 mA, 38 V, 1 uA IQ, with PG
ncp730_ds.note: 33 pages. Pages 1-30 carry a printed page number equal to the PDF page; 31-33 are the package drawings (TSOP-5 CASE 483 p.31, WDFN6 2x2 CASE 511BR with its recommended mounting footprint p.32) and the legal page. The text layer sets the micro sign in a symbol font that pdftotext extracts as 'm' (so '1 uF' reads '1 mF', '1 uA' reads '1 mA'); quotes elide those units with '...'. www.onsemi.com/download/data-sheet/pdf/ncp730-d.pdf refused scripted downloads (Access Denied); the LCSC copy for C892821 is the older Rev. 1 (March 2021), not used.
